name: Ayashiki Tougenkyou no Arias
original_name: 絢しき灯幻鏡のアリアス
source:
Guided by a white-clad young man, you set foot in a beautiful secluded village in pursuit of secrets.
There, you will play the role of a "substitute" Uneme, serving the village's guardian deity, Mikagami-sama――

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/OtomateWeb/status/2099114275805503641]official X[/url]]
translation:
在一袭白衣的青年引领下，追寻秘密的你踏入了一座美丽而与世隔绝的隐秘村落。
在那里，你将扮演侍奉村落守护神“御镜大人”的采女“替身”——

[译自[url=https://x.com/OtomateWeb/status/2099114275805503641]官方X[/url]]
